visualCharacteristics.purpose: Inset panel with an image beside a heading, paragraph and button
observed: Image | h2 "A Common Foundation for Every Longhorn" + paragraph + CTA "More About the New Core"

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: image | heading, paragraph, CTA link
notes: Fixed side-by-side layout of an image and text that never wraps; section hint is block.

usage: Single mid-page promotion of a program or initiative.
reuseGuidance: Use for one image-and-text promo; when the text column carries stats use columns-impact.
